name: Panel Linear Service
description: Defines LinearService features (manually routed electrical or plumbing runs) for a panel component's 'features' input. When the panel is populated, every core beam the service crosses is drilled through ('core_drilling') or notched from the interior face ('frame_notching'). Sheathing is not cut. Holes over 40% and notches over 25% of the beam depth are reported in the populator's DebugInfo.

inputParameters.name: polylines
inputParameters.description: Service paths, drawn on or parallel to the panel they belong to. They are placed on the core layer's mid-plane.

inputParameters.name: thickness
inputParameters.description: Diameter of the service: the hole diameter, or the notch width and depth.

inputParameters.name: routing_mode
inputParameters.description: 'core_drilling' (default): drill through each crossed beam on the core mid-plane. 'frame_notching': cut a lap notch into each crossed beam from the interior face.

outputParameters.name: features
outputParameters.description: Panel feature definitions. Connect to a panel component's 'features' input; each panel adds the ones that lie on it.
